A '''battle''' at [[Uviuy Exen/Legends|Uviuy Exen]] was a engagement during the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] liberation campaign after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Buoyed by the recent successes against [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Utoxx Prentioch]] and the capture of [[Reytha]] and [[Denon/Legends|Denon]], the New Republic sent a fleet<ref name="TEA" /> commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]]<ref name="Warfare" /> from [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]], which had been liberated [[4 ABY/Legends|two years earlier]], along the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]<ref name="TEA" /> in order to cut off the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="Warfare" />
